declarations.name: safeSourceUrl
declarations.description:
A link address the marker may follow: http(s), or relative to the page. Anything else (`javascript:`, `data:`) is
dropped, so a source taken from a model's output cannot run script when clicked.

declarations.name: safeIconUrl
declarations.description: An icon address the preview may load: what safeSourceUrl allows, plus inline `data:image/` icons.

declarations.name: sourceHost
declarations.description: The site an address belongs to, without `www.`: `https://www.nytimes.com/…` gives `nytimes.com`.

A numbered marker in generated text that names its source, like the inline citations of Perplexity and ChatGPT
search. The marker is a link to `href`; hovering or focusing it opens a preview card with the site, the page's title,
a snippet and the address, which the pointer can move into and which Escape closes.

The marker shows `index` (or the default slot's content, such as a site name), and a screen reader hears it as
"Source 1: <title>" in the page's language. Only http(s) and relative addresses become links: a `javascript:` or
other address in model output is dropped, and the marker then only opens its preview. The `preview` slot replaces the
card's content.

The preview is a `c2-hover-card`, so it opens after `open-delay` and never on touch, where a tap follows the link.
Put everything the card says somewhere a touch or keyboard-only reader can also reach it, such as a list of sources.

cssProperties.description: How far the marker rises above the baseline of the text it sits in.
cssProperties.name: --c2-citation__marker--vertical-align

cssProperties.description: Most lines of the snippet before it is cut with an ellipsis.
cssProperties.name: --c2-citation__snippet--line-clamp

cssParts.description: Component-owned marker region: a link to the source, or a button when there is no address to follow. It holds the default slot, whose fallback is the `index` number; assigned content, such as a site name, takes its place inside the marker's pill.
cssParts.name: marker

cssParts.description: The card's first line: the site's icon and name.
cssParts.name: source

cssParts.description: The address, at the foot of the card.
cssParts.name: url

slots.description: Replaces the marker's text (`index`), such as a site name.

members.name: index
members.description: The source's number, shown in the marker.

members.name: href
members.description: The source's address. Only http(s) and relative addresses become a link.

members.name: sourceTitle
members.description: The cited page's title, shown in the card and announced with the marker.

members.name: snippet
members.description: The passage the text draws on, shown in the card.

members.name: site
members.description: The site's name, shown above the title. Defaults to the address's host.

members.name: favicon
members.description: The site's icon. Only http(s), relative and `data:image/` addresses are loaded.

members.name: target
members.description: Where the link opens. A citation leaves the page the reader is on, so a new tab by default.

members.name: placement
members.description: Where the card opens beside the marker; it flips when there is no room.

members.name: openDelay
members.description: Milliseconds the pointer rests on the marker before the card opens.

members.name: markerName
members.description: What a screen reader hears for the marker: "Source 1: <title>".
